comments.author: ducaale
comments.why: Parser combinators as natural use of monads.
comments.text: To understand monads, I think it helps to know a language where expressing such a concept is more natural. Although I do not claim to know 100% what monads are yet, coming across these features made it easier for me to understand the concept a little bit. - Algebraic data types - OCaml's let expressions - F#'s computation expressions I also think that it is important to write something that naturally requires the use of monads. One thing that spring to mind is Parser Combinators. - [LINK] - [VIDEO]
